title: Claude Tag: AI Teammate in Slack
content:
## Overview

Claude Tag is Anthropic's Slack-native AI teammate product, launched in beta on June 23, 2026, for Claude Enterprise and Team customers. It embeds a shared `@Claude` identity directly into Slack workspaces — one that accumulates institutional knowledge over time, executes multi-step tasks asynchronously, and can accept handoffs mid-task from one employee to another.

Claude Tag is built on Claude Opus 4.8 and is part of Anthropic's enterprise agent lineup alongside Claude Code and Cowork.

---

## How It Works

### Invocation

Employees mention `@Claude` in any connected Slack channel or thread. Claude Tag acknowledges the request, breaks it into stages, and executes them independently — calling tools, querying connected data sources, and scheduling follow-up steps without waiting for a human to re-engage.

### Asynchronous Execution

Claude Tag is designed for tasks that span minutes, hours, or days. After receiving a task, it works in the background and delivers results to the channel when complete. Examples:

- Draft a competitive analysis report overnight by querying connected data sources
- Monitor a data pipeline and post a summary to `#data-ops` when anomalies appear
- Coordinate a multi-step onboarding sequence across a new hire's first week

### Institutional Memory

A single `@Claude` identity is shared across the organization. As it works, Claude Tag accumulates organizational context: terminology, project history, team conventions. Multiple employees can hand off work to the same `@Claude` instance — task state persists across handoffs, so Claude doesn't need to be re-briefed.

---

## Configuration and Access Controls

System administrators control Claude Tag at a per-channel level:

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| Tool access | Which MCP-connected tools `@Claude` can use in a given channel |
| Data scope | Which memory, documents, and integrations are accessible |
| Channel enablement | Which channels `@Claude` is active in |

This granularity allows an engineering channel to have code execution and GitHub access while a legal channel has only document search — same `@Claude` identity, different capability surfaces.

---

## Enterprise MCP Integration

Claude Tag connects to enterprise systems through Anthropic's MCP connector layer. As of June 2026, Okta-provisioned connectors provide zero-touch setup: administrators provision connectors once, and users get access on first login across Claude chat, Claude Code, and Claude Tag simultaneously — no per-user configuration required.

---

## Relationship to Cowork and Claude Code

Claude Tag, Cowork, and Claude Code share the same MCP connector infrastructure and enterprise authentication layer and are designed to interoperate:

- A task started in Claude Tag can invoke a Claude Code agent for a coding step, then return results to the Slack channel
- Cowork (the canvas-based collaboration workspace) can surface documents that `@Claude` is working on
- All three products share the same organizational memory and tool access provisioned by IT administrators

Anthropic positions this trio as complementary interfaces to the same underlying agentic system rather than separate products.

---
